provider: Item Metadata API (MDAPI) as free key-value/JSON store

free_tier.stated: No per-item metadata size is published; unlimited items x one JSON doc each, transaction-safe, free.

tooling: ia metadata -m / Python MDAPI; auth via the same IAS3 keys (Authorization: LOW)
chaining: Side-car index for the 20TiB: one small JSON doc per item holding checksums, shard maps, source URLs — solves IAS3's 'cannot list all my items' problem without running your own database.

limits.value: unverified: writes are tasks limited per user over a period, HTTP 429 Too Many Requests at the threshold; the threshold is not published

limits_note: One item per call, no wildcarding; custom fields must follow XML naming; writes are queued like any other item transaction; not intended for bulk blob data.

identity_cost.detail: Internet Archive account (email address, screen name, password); the S3 keys used for MDAPI writes come from that account.

reliability_note: Safe for bookkeeping, useless for bytes; concurrent writers need the documented concurrency pattern or they clobber metadata.
confidence_note: reported: vendor pages read on 2026-11-03 show the sign-up fields (https://archive.org/account/signup), the per-user write task limit (https://archive.org/developers/md-write.html) and the one-item-per-call rule (https://archive.org/developers/metadata.html). The free allowance and the write threshold are not stated there; retention and per-object cap were not read.
